description: Get Vedic astrology predictions for a zodiac sign or from birth details. Daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly. If rashi (zodiac sign) is provided, returns sign-based prediction. If birth datetime is provided, Moon sign is derived automatically. First call per sign per day is charged; subsequent calls same sign+day are cached (free). Accepts English (aries-pisces) and Hindi (mesha-meena) sign names. Cost: $0.020-0.088/call.

datetime.description: Birth datetime (ISO 8601) to auto-derive Moon sign instead of rashi.

period.description: Prediction period. daily=$0.020, weekly=$0.028, monthly=$0.040, quarterly=$0.056, yearly=$0.088.

rashi.description: Zodiac sign. English or Hindi. Either rashi OR datetime required.

name: vedika_predictions
